title: Impacts of the EU inverter ban
content:

title: Storage leading growth in Denmark’s energy market
content:

The interest spans across market segments, with market signals and electricity price volatility acting as key drivers.

title: The Smarter E spotlights Renewables 24/7
content:
The German trade fair was fully booked again this year. Although there are slightly fewer exhibitors than in 2025, average stand sizes have increased. Exhibitors showcased their products and services—ranging from photovoltaics and battery storage to electromobility, energy management and connectivity—through to Thursday. A special exhibition captures the fair’s core concept under the title “Renewables 24/7.”

title: Australia: AEMO calls for 35GW of short and medium-duration storage plus 5GW of long-duration storage by 2050
content: AEMO has set out a storage requirement of almost 50GW in its latest 2026 Integrated System Plan (ISP), split between 35GW of short and medium-duration battery storage for daily firming and 5GW of long-duration energy storage (LDES) for seasonal reliability.
